notes.b1/j1/B-r1: Convincing glass dome with gold collar and wood base, a cozy hollow scene and glittery churn, though the control panel is a bit busy.
notes.b1/j1/C-r1: Fisheye-distorted rooftop city with lit windows is inventive and rich, but odd translucent rectangle reflections and the pedestal base read less like a classic snow globe.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Classic, clean globe with cabin, moon, snowdrift and a brass plaque; snow is plentiful but the scene is small and the controls sit below the fold.
notes.b1/j1/C-r2: Beautiful lighthouse scene and glass, but there is no base so it reads as a bubble on a table and the layout is crowded.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Tidy and legible with falling snow and settling drift, but the flat base and plain gradients feel simplistic.
notes.b1/j1/B-r2: Charming shelf staging with candle, books and plant, but the globe is small and washed out, the snow sparse, and the panel overlaps the scene and hides controls on mobile.
notes.b1/j2/C-r2: Lovely glass and lighthouse, but the base is cropped into a murky dome so it reads as a glass sphere in a room, not a globe on a base.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Clean, classic dome, wooden base and plaque with a charming cottage; flat vector styling and a rather blank snow floor, with a tidy centered layout.
notes.b1/j2/B-r2: Cozy shelf with candle, books and plant and a tilting shake gives great context, but the globe is small, the scene is tiny, and the control panel overlaps the scene.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Unmistakable snow globe with polished gold-trimmed base, plaque, glowing cabin and moon; dense snow reads well and the phone layout stacks cleanly.
notes.b1/j2/C-r1: Ambitious fisheye-refracted rooftop city is clever, but the snow looks like noisy confetti and the dark base is muted.
notes.b1/j2/B-r1: Richest glass with rim, specular highlight, depth-layered forest cottage, wood-grain base and brass plaque, with believable swirling flakes and a clear control panel.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Classic night cottage globe on a wooden plinth with clean snow and a shake that settles, a bit flat but very readable and tidy on phone.
notes.b1/j3/B-r2: Charming shelf vignette with candle, books and plant and a tilting shake, but the globe is small, the control panel covers the scene, and snow reads faint.
notes.b1/j3/C-r2: Beautiful glass and lighthouse with glitter, but the dome has no base so it reads as a glass ball on a table, and the wide panel crowds the layout.
notes.b1/j3/B-r1: Best glass, depth and layered scene with gold rim and wooden base, glitter churns and settles convincingly, though the side panel is busy.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Polished cabin globe with a gold collar, dense snow and a nice tilt on shake, controls sit tidily below and work on phone.
notes.b1/j3/C-r1: Inventive fisheye rooftop city with a dark base, but the snow reads as confetti and the scene is murky and less obviously a snow globe.
notes.b2/j1/B-r3: Convincing blue-liquid dome with a gold collar, wooden plinth and snowy cabin, but the big slider panel crowds the staging and the snow is faint.
notes.b2/j1/C-r3: Charming lamplit shelf room with a red music-box base, but the globe is tiny and its scene is hard to read.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Polished night cabin with moon, smoke, pines and a snowy mound inside a clean glass dome on a wooden base, tidy controls, good phone layout.
notes.b2/j1/C-r4: Beautiful glass and glitter, but no scene inside and the dome overlaps the base oddly, so it reads more as a glitter ball.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Clear and cheerful daytime snow globe with a cabin, but flat drawing, a thin base and sparse snow.
notes.b2/j1/B-r4: Cozy room with a cabin and trees under a pale dome, but the globe sits tilted at rest, the scene looks washed out and the bottom bar is cramped.
notes.b2/j2/C-r4: Handsome glass and base but no scene inside, snow is a glitter smear on the floor, and the control panel is cut off on desktop.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Clear snow globe with cabin and trees and falling flakes, but flat and simple, the base is clunky, and shaken snow hugs the top.
notes.b2/j2/B-r4: Warm shelf scene with a nice cabin and tilting globe, but the base overhangs the dome oddly and the globe looks washed out.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Polished night cabin with moon, smoke and glowing windows, a cohesive layout and good phone layout, though the base is a little plain.
notes.b2/j2/C-r3: Richly staged room with lamp and window, but the globe is tiny and the flakes are hard to read.
notes.b2/j2/B-r3: Large, convincing glass dome with believable depth, brass collar and wooden base, and fine drifting snow, though the side panel is busy and snow is sparse.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Clear dome-on-base with a cabin, but flat and cartoonish, the base is an odd trapezoid, and snow hangs at the top at rest.
notes.b2/j3/B-r4: Warm shelf scene with a tilting globe on shake and a cozy cabin, though the dome interior looks hazy and the bright wall is a bit plain.
notes.b2/j3/C-r4: Beautiful glassy sphere with glitter, but there is no scene inside, so it reads as a crystal ball more than a snow globe, and the controls spill below the fold.
notes.b2/j3/B-r3: Large, convincing dome with a lit cabin, snowy ground, brass collar and wooden base; fine flakes churn well, though the side panel is heavy.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Polished night scene with moon, smoking cabin and pines, snow that settles into drifts, a base that tilts on shake and a clean phone layout.
notes.b2/j3/C-r3: Rich room diorama with lamp, window and books, but the globe is small and cluttered, which makes the actual subject secondary.
